author: @notjazii
title: Fable 5.5 战斗动画
summary: 展示 Claude Fable 5.5 生成战斗动画的灵活能力，强调模型泛化潜力。
summary_en: Highlights Claude Fable 5.5’s flexible ability to generate combat animations and its broad potential.

author: @imjustnewatai
title: SVG版GTA6沙滩动画
summary: Fable 5.5用单文件SVG生成GTA风格沙滩动画，包含海浪、打斗与物理效果。
summary_en: Fable 5.5 generated a self-contained SVG animation of GTA 6 beach scenes with physics.
prompt: I asked Fable 5.5, to create an SVG animation of GTA 6 on a crowded, sunny beach. A German shepherd takes a shit in the sand, then the player gets into a fistfight with a nearby NPC. Include photorealistic graphics, realistic physics, ocean waves, animated beachgoers, a third-person camera, and a GTA-style minimap. Render everything in one self-contained SVG file.

author: @notjazii
title: 生命之树生成动画
summary: Fable 5.5 单次生成纯代码动画，展示复杂视觉创作能力。
summary_en: Fable 5.5 generated a complex life tree animation with pure code in one shot.

author: @0xMovez
title: Fable 5.5 一次生成42秒动画
summary: 使用纯Three.js与代码渲染生成高质量动画，无需视频模型且离线运行。
summary_en: One-shot 42-second Three.js animation without video models, fully offline.

author: @chetaslua
title: 纯代码视频惊艳模型
summary: 用单一提示词生成高质量视频，效果优于AI视频模型。
summary_en: A single prompt generates high-quality video, outperforming AI video models.

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 全矢量发条鸟零件飞入组装、连续镜头
纯数学合成音效（点击与帧精确同步 ±5ms）
prompt: 一句提示词（未公开完整原文）
summary: 全矢量发条鸟自动组装成片，原创华尔兹与纯数学合成音效贯穿。
title: Clockwork Bird（发条鸟）
summary_en: A fully vector clockwork bird assembles itself on camera, with an original waltz and purely math-synthesized sound effects throughout.
highlights_en: Vector clockwork-bird parts fly in and assemble; one continuous shot

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 单脚本完整建模（Triforce 浮雕、编织握把、多层羽毛护手）
连续运镜 + 森林光影 + 原创管弦乐
prompt: Build Link's Master Sword in Blender（后续追加“make a video of it”）
summary: 单脚本在 Blender 中建模大师之剑并自动成片，附原创管弦乐。
title: Link's Master Sword
summary_en: Link's Master Sword modeled and filmed by a single Blender script, with an original orchestral score.
highlights_en: Complete single-script modeling (Triforce relief, braided grip, layered feather guard)
Continuous camera move, forest lighting, original orchestral score

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 骨骼 + 120Hz 布料、闪电刀 vs 火焰大剑
228 个物理同步音效（其中 79 个自动从剑尖速度检测）
prompt: Make me a video of 2 stickman fighting, anime style.
summary: 动漫风火柴人剑斗：布料模拟、冲击闪与 228 个物理同步音效。
title: Anime Stickman Sword Fight
summary_en: Anime-style stickman sword fight: cloth simulation, impact flashes and 228 physics-synced sound effects.
highlights_en: Rigged bones + 120Hz cloth; lightning katana vs flame greatsword
228 physics-synced SFX (79 auto-detected from sword-tip velocity)
Full silence right before the climax

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 51 关节完整绑定 + 地面求解
64 个纯合成音效（柴油/气刹/舵机等）
prompt: Make me a transformer truck with animations of its transforming.
summary: 51 关节绑定变形卡车，雨幕涟漪与纯合成机械音效。
title: Transformer Truck
summary_en: A fully rigged transforming truck with Geometry Nodes rain, ripples and fully synthesized mechanical sounds.
highlights_en: 64 fully synthesized SFX (diesel, air brakes, servos)

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 完整蒸汽机→齿轮系→四足行走（从着地脚反解）
自动发现并优化草渲染（9.3s→4.2s/帧）
prompt: Make me Howl's moving castle and also show its internal machinery.
summary: 会行走的城堡：蒸汽机到四足步态全建模，中途开壳剖视。
title: Howl's Moving Castle
summary_en: A walking castle: full steam-engine-to-gait modeling with a mid-video shell cutaway.
highlights_en: Complete steam engine → gear train → four-legged gait (solved from the planted foot)

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 自动排查隐藏灯光问题
prompt: Make a mechanical heart and show its insides, use blender.
summary: 机械心脏开壳动画：双活塞曲轴与心跳同步配乐。
title: Mechanical Heart
summary_en: A mechanical heart with a cutaway animation: twin-piston crankshaft and a heartbeat-synced score.

author: @camperaigg
highlights: 三层 FFT 波浪 + cel-shading
自动发现并重渲染交叉线问题
prompt: Make a whale breach a cel-shaded ocean.
summary: 1690 万粒子流体与 cel-shading 海洋，鲸鱼跃水成片。
title: Whale Breach
summary_en: A whale breaches a cel-shaded ocean: 16.9M-particle fluid and a 1.09M-triangle whale built purely in code.
